units: Nidd. 43ᵃ בשרו חם his membrum excited.—Pl. חַמִּים, חַמִּין (sub. מים) hot water.
Sabb. 134ᵇ ח׳ שהוחמו וכ׳ hot water which was made hot on the Sabbath; a. fr.—חַמֵּי טבריה the hot springs of Tiberias, in gen. natural hot water, opp. to חמי האור water heated by fire.
Ḥull. 8ᵃ (Neg. IX, 1 מֵי); a. fr.—Fem. חַמָּה.
<cite ref="Mishnah Makhshirin 3:3">Makhsh. III, 3</cite> <he>פת ח׳</he> hot bread.
